reason: Read published augmentation-nilpotence proof and Webb Corollary 11.6.3 with its proof. A nonzero summand has fixed vectors; transitivity gives a one-dimensional fixed space and hence indecomposability. For T properly below L, the coefficient of Higman trace at L is constant on L-orbits of R/T, each of p-divisible size, contradicting the identity coefficient. This proves the vertex over every field of characteristic p. See research/phase-2-catchup-24-step3b-e.md.
